items.summary: Threat actors used the open-source AI penetration-testing framework Cairn to find a previously unknown vulnerability in a medical imaging application. [...]

items.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September

items.title: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info
items.summary: J.P. Morgan Chase warned it suffered a data breach after a cyberattack at a third-party service provider exposed customers' personal information and marketing data. [...]

items.summary: N-able says attackers who breached one of its servers have caused a major outage affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services worldwide. [...]

items.title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million
items.summary: Threat actors accessed databases containing customer information associated with clinics in Japan. The post SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
items.summary: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]

items.title: Ruby Patches Ruby2Shell Vulnerability That Could Lead to RCE
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-132825, the bug is a heap-based buffer overflow that could lead to remote code execution (RCE). The post Ruby Patches Ruby2Shell Vulnerability That Could Lead to RCE appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak
items.summary: The companies point to third-party providers after the N0n extortion group leaked data allegedly tied to their customers. The post JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Cite Third-Party Incidents Amid Data Leak appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
items.summary: Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]

items.title: WhatsApp Fixes Flaw Uncovered While Disrupting Scam Campaign
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-23871, the vulnerability was found by WhatsApp’s security team, and it may have been used to make scam messages more credible. The post WhatsApp Fixes Flaw Uncovered While Disrupting Scam Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
items.summary: Tracking company passwords in spreadsheets can leave IT administrators unaware of weak, reused, or compromised credentials stored and shared outside approved systems. NordPass explains how centralized password management can improve credential visibility, identify security risks, and simplify secure password sharing. [...]

items.title: Industry Reactions to Major Outages and AI Patching Debate: Feedback Friday
items.summary: Experts commented on whether AI-accelerated patching played a role, the need for tested rollback plans, and the fragility of interconnected systems. The post Industry Reactions to Major Outages and AI Patching Debate: Feedback Friday appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Microsoft now automatically installs Windows 11 26H2 on unmanaged devices

items.title: European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services
items.summary: The Commission took certain services offline to contain the incident, but it has no evidence of a data breach. The post European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes

items.title: N-able Blames Service Disruption on Cyberattack

items.title: ASUS warns of critical hard-coded key flaw in Control Center Express
items.summary: ASUS released Control Center Express v1.7.29 to fix three critical vulnerabilities that could let remote attackers gain administrative control of the management console and the devices it manages. [...]

items.title: Transport for London breach exposes 265,000 Oyster card users' data

items.title: PHP Patches Seven Critical RCE Vulnerabilities

items.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
items.summary: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups. [...]

items.title: Critical NGINX ‘NGINX2Root’ bugs let attackers hijack servers
items.summary: Two critical NGINX vulnerabilities dubbed "nginx2root" allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely on vulnerable web servers, with researchers demonstrating how the flaws can be chained with a Linux kernel bug to gain root access. [...]

items.title: Hackers steal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers
items.summary: SBC Medical Group has warned in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that two cybersecurity incidents exposed sensitive customer and employee information, including personal data belonging to 1.6 million people. [...]

items.title: Le strategie di Cina e Stati Uniti sull’intelligenza artificiale
items.summary: Potenza o efficienza? Mano libera o pianificazione? Modelli aperti o proprietari? Le due superpotenze stanno seguendo strade profondamente diverse nella corsa all’AI. A decretare il vincitore potrebbe però essere un altro elemento: chi riuscirà a sostenerne i costi.
